say:14:1611020011:0.text: Because his recovery was his secret, and I revealed it to you without his consent.

say:14:1611020011:0.female: Because his recovery was his secret, and I revealed it to you without his consent.

say:15:1611020012:0.text: According to my family's code, that's a betrayal of a friend. But with the headmaster's death... I had to say something.
say:15:1611020012:0.source_cn: 按照我们家族的骑士准则，这是一种对朋友的背叛。可这件事...

say:16:1611020013:0.text: I meant it as an apology. I don't even know why I did it... Maybe I just made everything worse.

choice:7:2:3.female: Why would you give a fragment to him?

say:21:1611020016:0.text: Why would you give me your fragment?

say:22:1611020017:0.source_cn: 我……这是我的歉意。我知道你不愿意自己双腿恢复健康的事...

say:26:1611020021:0.text: Succeed? Help me? Don't make me laugh.

say:27:1611020022:0.text: Don't be so naive, Silven. You can't help me. You have no right to pity me.
say:27:1611020022:0.source_cn: 哈哈哈，太天真了，休！你没有能力帮助我，也没有资格怜悯我。

say:28:1611020023:0.text: I don't need your help, and your weak apology is meaningless. Now that <style="stress"><player_name></style> knows I can walk, I'm sure he'll piece the rest together soon enough.
